# DiggerTerm v0.0.3

### 简体中文

- 新增用户 JSON/CSS 配色主题、快捷键录制与校验、左右/上下嵌套分屏和布局恢复。
- 改进 nano/Vim 等全屏程序的选区复制，新增只读复制模式、工具栏和右键复制/粘贴入口。
- 新增手动 Daemon 重连、退出码/PTY 流诊断和输出回放截断提示。
- Windows 支持已安装的 Git Bash；Linux/macOS 使用本机 Bash。Windows 未安装 Git Bash 时不会启动 WSL 的 `bash.exe`。

**下载：** [Windows x64 EXE](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/DiggerTerm-v0.0.3-windows-amd64.exe)、[Linux x86_64 AppImage](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/DiggerTerm-v0.0.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage)、[Ubuntu/Debian amd64 DEB](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/DiggerTerm-v0.0.3-linux-amd64.deb)、[SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/SHA256SUMS)。

> Windows 包未签名。Linux 包主要在 Ubuntu 24.04 验证。画面恢复仍是最近 256 KiB 的原始输出回放，不保证还原完整全屏状态；SSH 现场闲置断联问题仍待复现。更新 Daemon 前请先完成已有会话。

### English

- Added user JSON/CSS themes, shortcut recording and validation, nested horizontal/vertical panes, and layout restore.
- Improved copy for nano/Vim-style full-screen applications, with read-only copy mode and toolbar/context-menu controls.
- Added manual daemon reconnection, exit-code/PTY-stream diagnostics, and bounded-output replay warnings.
- Windows supports an installed Git Bash; Linux/macOS use native Bash. Windows never substitutes the WSL `bash.exe` when Git Bash is missing.

**Downloads:** [Windows x64 EXE](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/DiggerTerm-v0.0.3-windows-amd64.exe), [Linux x86_64 AppImage](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/DiggerTerm-v0.0.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage), [Ubuntu/Debian amd64 DEB](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/DiggerTerm-v0.0.3-linux-amd64.deb), [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.3/SHA256SUMS).

> The Windows package is unsigned. Linux packages were primarily tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Recovery replays the latest 256 KiB of raw output and cannot restore every full-screen state. The reported idle SSH disconnect still needs field reproduction. Finish existing sessions before updating the daemon.
